metadata.name: [SRE] K8s OOM phrase in container logs
metadata.description: P1: container logs matched Out of memory / OutOfMemoryError / OOMKilled (phrase / QSTR — not loose MATCH).

breach.query:
FROM logs-kubernetes.container_logs.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE QSTR("body.text:\"Out of memory.\" OR body.text:\"Out of memory\" OR body.text:\"OutOfMemoryError\" OR body.text:\"java.lang.OutOfMemoryError\" OR body.text:OOMKilled OR body.text:\"OutOfMemoryException\"")
| WHERE `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name` IS NOT NULL
| STATS hits = COUNT(*),
        pods = COUNT_DISTINCT(`resource.attributes.k8s.pod.name`)
    BY `resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name`
| WHERE hits > 0
| KEEP `resource.attributes.k8s.cluster.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.namespace.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.deployment.name`,
       `resource.attributes.k8s.container.name`,
       hits,
       pods
